column2:
backyard(n.)後院
(無詞性變化)
in the backyard 在後院
not in my backyard 別在我家附近(鄰避)
My father planted several fruit trees in our backyard last spring.
(我爸爸去年春天在我們家後院種了幾棵果樹。)
Many residents oppose building a garbage plant in their own backyard.
(許多居民反對在自家附近興建垃圾處理廠。)

ballot(n./v.)選票、無記名投票、投票表決
(無詞性變化)
secret ballot 無記名投票
cast a ballot 投票
The class leader was chosen by secret ballot this year.
(今年班長是以無記名投票方式選出的。)
Millions of citizens cast their ballots in the presidential election.
(數百萬名公民在總統大選中投下了他們的選票。)

ban(n./v.)禁令、禁止
(無詞性變化)
a ban on 對…的禁令
be banned from 被禁止…
The government announced a ban on single-use plastic straws.
(政府宣布禁止使用一次性塑膠吸管。)
Students are banned from using their phones during exams.
(學生在考試期間禁止使用手機。)

banner(n.)橫幅、旗幟、標語
(無詞性變化)
hang a banner 掛布條
under the banner of 打著…的旗號
The students hung a large banner to welcome the new principal.
(學生們掛上一條大布條來歡迎新校長。)
Fans waved banners and shouted as the team entered the stadium.
(球隊進場時，球迷們揮舞旗幟並大聲歡呼。)

barren(adj.)貧瘠的、荒蕪的、不孕的
(無詞性變化)
barren land 不毛之地
barren desert 荒涼的沙漠
Nothing could grow on the barren land after years of drought.
(經過多年乾旱，這片貧瘠的土地上什麼都長不出來。)
The explorers walked for days across the barren desert.
(探險家們在荒涼的沙漠中走了好幾天。)

batch(n.)一批、一爐、一組
(無詞性變化)
a batch of 一批…
in batches 分批地
My mom baked a fresh batch of cookies for the school bazaar.
(我媽媽為學校義賣烤了一批新鮮的餅乾。)
The new phones will be shipped to stores in batches.
(新手機將分批運送到各家店面。)

behalf(n.)代表、利益
(無詞性變化)
on behalf of 代表…
on sb.'s behalf 代表某人、為了某人
On behalf of our class, I would like to thank all the teachers.
(我謹代表全班感謝所有的老師。)
My lawyer will speak on my behalf at the meeting.
(我的律師將在會議上代表我發言。)

belongings(n.)財物、所有物
belong(v.)屬於
personal belongings 個人物品
pack one's belongings 收拾行李
Please take all your personal belongings with you when you leave the train.
(下車時請攜帶您所有的隨身物品。)
He packed his belongings into two suitcases and moved out.
(他把所有家當裝進兩個行李箱就搬出去了。)

beloved(adj./n.)心愛的、親愛的、心愛的人
love(v.)愛
beloved pet 心愛的寵物
dearly beloved 最親愛的
The whole family was heartbroken when their beloved dog passed away.
(心愛的狗過世時，全家人都非常傷心。)
The old singer is still beloved by fans of all ages.
(那位資深歌手至今仍深受各年齡層歌迷的喜愛。)

beneficial(adj.)有益的、有利的
benefit(n./v.)好處、得益
beneficiary(n.)受益人
beneficial to/for 對…有益
mutually beneficial 互惠的
Getting enough sleep is beneficial to both your body and your mind.
(充足的睡眠對身體和心理都有益處。)
The two companies reached a mutually beneficial agreement.
(這兩家公司達成了一項互惠的協議。)

betray(v.)背叛、出賣、洩露
betrayal(n.)背叛
betray one's trust 辜負某人的信任
betray a secret 洩露祕密
I will never forgive him for betraying my trust.
(我永遠不會原諒他辜負了我的信任。)
Her shaking voice betrayed how nervous she really was.
(她顫抖的聲音洩露了她其實有多緊張。)

beware(v.)當心、注意
(無詞性變化)
beware of 小心…
Beware of the dog. 內有惡犬。
Beware of pickpockets when you travel in crowded places.
(在擁擠的地方旅行時要小心扒手。)
Internet users should beware of emails asking for personal information.
(網路使用者應該留意要求提供個人資料的電子郵件。)

bias(n./v.)偏見、偏袒、使有偏見
biased(adj.)有偏見的
bias against 對…的偏見
gender bias 性別偏見
Judges must make decisions without any personal bias.
(法官必須在沒有任何個人偏見的情況下做出判決。)
Some news reports are biased in favor of one political party.
(有些新聞報導偏袒某一個政黨。)

bid(n./v.)出價、投標、努力爭取
bidder(n.)出價者、投標者
make a bid 出價
in a bid to 試圖…
He made a bid of five thousand dollars for the old painting.
(他對那幅古畫出價五千元。)
The city cut taxes in a bid to attract more businesses.
(該市降低稅收，試圖吸引更多企業進駐。)

biological(adj.)生物的、生物學的、親生的
biology(n.)生物學
biologist(n.)生物學家
biological parents 親生父母
biological weapons 生物武器
After growing up, she decided to look for her biological parents.
(長大後，她決定尋找她的親生父母。)
Scientists study the biological effects of air pollution on children.
(科學家研究空氣汙染對兒童造成的生物影響。)

bizarre(adj.)古怪的、異乎尋常的
(無詞性變化)
bizarre behavior 古怪的行為
a bizarre story 離奇的故事
Everyone was confused by his bizarre behavior at the party.
(大家對他在派對上的古怪行為感到困惑。)
The newspaper reported a bizarre story about a cat that rode the bus every day.
(報紙報導了一則有隻貓每天搭公車的離奇故事。)

blast(n./v.)爆炸、一陣強風、大聲播放、炸開
(無詞性變化)
a blast of 一陣…
have a blast 玩得很開心
A blast of cold wind hit us as we opened the door.
(我們一開門就被一陣冷風吹襲。)
We had a blast at the music festival last weekend.
(我們上週末在音樂祭玩得超開心。)

blur(n./v.)模糊的事物、使模糊
blurry(adj.)模糊的
a blur of 一片模糊的…
blur the line between 模糊…之間的界線
Without my glasses, everything is just a blur.
(沒戴眼鏡時，所有東西都只是一片模糊。)
Social media has blurred the line between public and private life.
(社群媒體模糊了公共生活與私人生活之間的界線。)

blush(n./v.)臉紅、腮紅
(無詞性變化)
blush with embarrassment 尷尬得臉紅
make sb. blush 使某人臉紅
She blushed when her classmates praised her singing.
(同學們稱讚她的歌聲時，她臉紅了。)
His sweet words made her blush with embarrassment.
(他的甜言蜜語讓她害羞得臉紅。)

bodyguard(n.)保鑣、護衛
(無詞性變化)
personal bodyguard 私人保鑣
hire a bodyguard 雇用保鑣
The famous singer always travels with two bodyguards.
(那位知名歌手總是帶著兩名保鑣出門。)
The rich businessman hired a bodyguard after receiving threats.
(那位富商在收到威脅後雇用了一名保鑣。)

bolt(n./v.)門閂、螺栓、閃電、閂上、逃跑
(無詞性變化)
a bolt of lightning 一道閃電
a bolt from the blue 晴天霹靂
The news of his sudden death came as a bolt from the blue.
(他突然過世的消息宛如晴天霹靂。)
The frightened horse bolted when it heard the thunder.
(受驚的馬聽到雷聲便狂奔逃跑。)

bonus(n.)獎金、紅利、額外的好處
(無詞性變化)
year-end bonus 年終獎金
an added bonus 額外的好處
Employees will receive a year-end bonus before the Lunar New Year.
(員工將在農曆新年前領到年終獎金。)
The hotel is close to the beach, and the free breakfast is an added bonus.
(這家飯店離海邊很近，免費早餐更是額外的好處。)

boom(n./v.)繁榮、激增、隆隆聲、迅速發展
(無詞性變化)
economic boom 經濟繁榮
baby boom 嬰兒潮
The country enjoyed an economic boom in the 1980s.
(這個國家在一九八〇年代經歷了經濟繁榮。)
Online shopping has boomed in recent years.
(網路購物近年來蓬勃發展。)

boost(v./n.)提升、增加、促進、激勵
booster(n.)增強劑、加強針
boost confidence 增強信心
boost the economy 刺激經濟
Winning the speech contest really boosted her confidence.
(贏得演講比賽大大提升了她的自信心。)
The government hopes the new policy will give the economy a boost.
(政府希望新政策能刺激經濟。)

booth(n.)攤位、小隔間、亭子
(無詞性變化)
phone booth 電話亭
ticket booth 售票亭
Our class set up a booth to sell drinks at the school fair.
(我們班在校慶園遊會上設了一個攤位賣飲料。)
There are fewer and fewer phone booths on the streets these days.
(現在街上的電話亭越來越少了。)

boredom(n.)無聊、厭倦
bored(adj.)感到無聊的
boring(adj.)令人無聊的
out of boredom 出於無聊
relieve boredom 解悶
He started playing video games out of boredom during the long holiday.
(長假期間，他出於無聊開始打電玩。)
Reading novels helps me relieve boredom on long train rides.
(讀小說能幫我在漫長的火車旅程中解悶。)

bound(v./n.)跳躍、以…為界、界限
bound(adj.)一定的、受約束的、開往…的
be bound to 必然會…
out of bounds 禁止進入、越界
If you keep practicing, you are bound to improve.
(只要你持續練習，一定會進步。)
This area of the school is out of bounds to students after six p.m.
(晚上六點以後，學生禁止進入校園的這個區域。)

boundary(n.)邊界、界限
(無詞性變化)
national boundary 國界
set boundaries 設定界限
The river forms a natural boundary between the two towns.
(這條河形成兩個鎮之間的天然邊界。)
It is important to set clear boundaries in a friendship.
(在友誼中設定清楚的界限是很重要的。)

boxer(n.)拳擊手
box(v.)拳擊
boxing(n.)拳擊運動
professional boxer 職業拳擊手
boxer shorts 四角褲
Muhammad Ali is one of the greatest boxers of all time.
(穆罕默德·阿里是史上最偉大的拳擊手之一。)
The young boxer trains in the gym for six hours a day.
(這位年輕拳擊手每天在健身房訓練六個小時。)

breakthrough(n.)突破、重大進展
(無詞性變化)
a major breakthrough 重大突破
make a breakthrough 取得突破
Scientists have made a major breakthrough in cancer research.
(科學家在癌症研究上取得了重大突破。)
After months of practice, she finally had a breakthrough in her piano playing.
(經過數月的練習，她的鋼琴演奏終於有了突破。)

briefcase(n.)公事包
(無詞性變化)
leather briefcase 皮製公事包
carry a briefcase 提著公事包
My father carries an old leather briefcase to work every day.
(我爸爸每天提著一個舊皮製公事包去上班。)
He opened his briefcase and took out a stack of documents.
(他打開公事包，拿出一疊文件。)

bronze(n./adj.)青銅、銅牌、青銅色的
(無詞性變化)
bronze medal 銅牌
Bronze Age 青銅器時代
Our school's team won a bronze medal in the national contest.
(我們學校的隊伍在全國比賽中贏得一面銅牌。)
The museum displays bronze tools from ancient China.
(博物館展示著來自古代中國的青銅器具。)

browse(v./n.)瀏覽、隨意翻閱、逛
browser(n.)瀏覽器
browse the internet 瀏覽網路
browse through 隨意翻閱
I spent the afternoon browsing through magazines in the bookstore.
(我花了一個下午在書店隨意翻閱雜誌。)
Many people browse online stores before buying anything in person.
(許多人在實體購物前會先瀏覽網路商店。)

bruise(n./v.)瘀傷、撞傷、使瘀傷
(無詞性變化)
cuts and bruises 割傷與瘀傷
a bruised ego 受挫的自尊
He fell off his bike and got a few cuts and bruises.
(他從腳踏車上摔下來，受了一些割傷和瘀傷。)
Handle the peaches carefully so you don't bruise them.
(小心拿那些桃子，以免把它們碰傷。)

bulk(n.)大量、大部分、巨大的體積
bulky(adj.)龐大的、笨重的
in bulk 大量地、整批地
the bulk of 大部分的…
Buying rice in bulk is cheaper for large families.
(對大家庭來說，大量購買米比較便宜。)
The bulk of the work was done by volunteers.
(大部分的工作是由志工完成的。)

bully(n./v.)霸凌者、恃強欺弱的人、霸凌
bullying(n.)霸凌
school bully 校園惡霸
be bullied 被霸凌
Students who are bullied should tell a teacher right away.
(被霸凌的學生應該立刻告訴老師。)
The school has started a program to stop cyber bullying.
(學校已推出一項防止網路霸凌的計畫。)

bureau(n.)局、處、事務所
(無詞性變化)
weather bureau 氣象局
tourism bureau 觀光局
The Central Weather Bureau issued a typhoon warning this morning.
(中央氣象局今天早上發布了颱風警報。)
You can get free maps from the tourism bureau.
(你可以從觀光局拿到免費地圖。)

bureaucracy(n.)官僚體制、官僚作風
bureaucrat(n.)官僚
bureaucratic(adj.)官僚的
government bureaucracy 政府官僚體系
cut through bureaucracy 突破繁文縟節
Too much bureaucracy slows down the decision-making process.
(過多的官僚作風會拖慢決策的過程。)
It took months to cut through the bureaucracy and get the permit.
(花了好幾個月突破繁瑣程序才拿到許可證。)

burial(n.)埋葬、葬禮
bury(v.)埋葬
burial ground 墓地
burial ceremony 葬禮
The ancient burial ground was discovered by local farmers.
(那片古老的墓地是由當地農民發現的。)
The burial ceremony was attended only by close family members.
(葬禮只有親近的家人出席。)

butcher(n./v.)屠夫、肉販、屠宰、殘殺
(無詞性變化)
butcher shop 肉舖
at the butcher's 在肉舖
My grandmother buys fresh pork from the butcher at the market.
(我奶奶在市場向肉販買新鮮豬肉。)
The farmer butchered a pig for the village festival.
(那位農夫為了村裡的節慶宰了一頭豬。)
